scope: Five remaining full-size identities; six original front/blank-back atlases because Posted Orders has two distinct sheet layers.
postprocessing: Byte-identical generated pixels copied to versioned repo paths. No raster edits, native images, game mesh extraction or repaint.
generator_deviations: Returned 1448x1086 RGB instead of the ideal 2048x1536; correct 4:3 atlas aspect.
Faint middle seams lie outside the inherited inset UV regions.
Order 7 heading occupies about the upper fifth rather than requested upper 14%; the smaller upper bulletin leaves that full heading exposed.
Rail stamp sits slightly lower than requested margin but remains safely above the modest physical tear.
decisions: Patrol, Schoolroom and Ledger share the original 1696-triangle source mesh with object-level materials; no bespoke geometry per story.
Rail uses a 3296-triangle closed shell with a real non-repeating torn bottom and undistorted artwork parameterization.

Orders use two closed 0.16 mm shells totaling 3392 triangles; first overlap read too subtly. One bounded refinement adds -1.2 degree in-plane angle, up to 1.8 mm extra local corner lift and 0.86 linear tint only on the older order.
Keep stories, current four-slot values, runtime icons, physics, game packages and saves unchanged until native integration.

assets.style: Front: an industrial freight transfer form. Plain slightly uneven dark charcoal typewriter text and fine gray table rules dividing the three wagon entries. A restrained faded brick-red rectangular DELAYED stamp below the entries. Top margin 12%, bottom 24% completely free of ink because a physical torn-bottom mesh will trim it. Do NOT draw a tear or missing piece in the image.

Front: a no-nonsense typed patrol locker warning, dark charcoal slightly worn typewriter ink. Small heading, three distinct short paragraphs, generous negative space below. Very faint old tape residue at two upper corners, no actual tape strip or object. Top margin 12%, bottom margin 14%.

Front: a practical shelter supplies list written in slightly uneven dark blue-black ballpoint handwriting on plain school office paper. Small heading and a short list, with the two count lines separated near the lower third. No invented checkmarks or ruled notebook spirals. Top/bottom margins 12%.

Front: a private handwritten ledger excerpt, faint desaturated gray bookkeeping rules, ordinary slightly hurried dark blue-black pen strokes, not a printed official form and not theatrical calligraphy. Restrained thumb wear, no blood/burns. A short heading and route followed by three owed entries. Make currency signs and amounts exact. Top/bottom margins 12%.
